trailhead.label: the Promenadenweg in Gatschach by the Wiesenhof, the board’s start (Nordic Walking centre “Nord”)

cautions: About 1 km of steeper, rougher track and path that OpenStreetMap grades as demanding mountain hiking (T3): sure-footed walking, no exposure.
Crosses the Praditz road (L7) near the start: keep your dog close.
Farm and forest tracks open to vehicles.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
